blocking_findings.problem: history() spans multiple SQLite snapshots because it does not start a read transaction; a normal concurrent commit can be misreported as LEDGER_CORRUPT.
blocking_findings.reproduction: Temporary ledger has one request. Reader fetches old event rows, another connection commits a valid second request, reader resumes and reports ledger head does not match immutable events. Immediate stable read returns healthy two requests/two events.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Pin one read transaction through schema/events/requests/results/per-request completions/final head; test both history and rebuild under deterministic concurrent commit. Return a coherent snapshot or explicit retryable concurrency error, never false corruption.
